title: arifOS Machine Contract Extension — typed declaration envelope
description: Candidate envelope for the four declarations the runtime does not yet make per tool: response_schema, outcomes, receipt.verification_uri, boundary. Every field carries an evidence state. DECLARED = explicitly supplied by the organ runtime or its typed registry. OBSERVED = derived from a captured runtime response or deployment configuration, not declared. UNKNOWN = neither declared nor safely established. OBSERVED is never promoted to DECLARED. null plus UNKNOWN is valid; fabricated completeness is invalid. Tool descriptions are prose, not typed declarations. An HTTP 200 does not by itself prove a public boundary. A receipt identifier does not prove a verification URI exists. Possible outcomes must not be confused with the verdict of one call. Minimum shape is a floor, not a ceiling: the provenance fields evidence_class, reason and does_not_imply are typed here so evidence is carried without opening additionalProperties. Conditional rule (if/then): when a field's state is UNKNOWN, its value MUST be null. A field that is not declared cannot carry an asserted value. This closes the gap where a class or value could be asserted beside an UNKNOWN state.

schema.description: JSON Schema object when DECLARED or OBSERVED; null when UNKNOWN.

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to the evidence artifact (probe record, source file:line). null when UNKNOWN.

evidence_class.description: Only DECLARED_TYPED counts toward typed runtime coverage.

does_not_imply.description: Explicit non-entailment. Required discipline: what this evidence does NOT prove.

richness.description: field_level = schema declares properties; bare_object = {type:object} with no properties (FastMCP `-> dict`).

observed_shape.description: Runtime-captured shape, kept SEPARATE from the declared schema. Never promoted to DECLARED.

allowed.description: Typed enumeration of possible outcome values. null when UNKNOWN. Never populated from the verdict of a single call.

evidence_class.description: Only DECLARED_TYPED counts toward typed runtime coverage.

does_not_imply.description: Explicit non-entailment. Required discipline: what this evidence does NOT prove.

observed_single_call_values_NOT_outcomes.description: Values seen in ONE response. Recorded for audit only; they are NOT the declared outcome set.

verification_uri.description: A URI that resolves to independent verification of the receipt. A receipt id alone does not qualify.

class.description: public = answers on a public route without authentication; internal = no public route; governed = public route with enforced authority gate. Set only from explicit policy or runtime/deployment declaration.
